_context_note: Batch sizing derives from context_window_tokens: a large window puts every changed definition in ONE call, which enables cross-file reasoning and avoids cross-batch duplicate findings. But do NOT simply copy max_model_len from GET /v1/models -- that is a PER-REQUEST ceiling, not a budget the server can honour concurrently. Size it from the KV cache instead: take 'GPU KV cache size: N tokens' and 'max_num_seqs: S' from the vLLM startup log and use at most N/S. Example measured 2026-08-02: N=3,091,332 and S=6 gives 515k, so 256k was chosen (12x concurrency, 2x headroom) even though max_model_len advertised 1,000,000 -- at 1M a single request reserves a third of the whole cache and three of them starve a server built for six sequences. Endpoints are shared across bots and overnight labs; leave room for all of them.
